usage: Trust the Whisper agent CA root with zero config: fetch /.well-known/whisper-ca.pem and point NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS at it (Node/Claude Code), and/or merge it into a bundle (system roots + this root) referenced by SSL_CERT_FILE / CURL_CA_BUNDLE / REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE / GIT_SSL_CAINFO. ALWAYS append, never replace the system bundle.
